1.name: Deas
1.temperament: thrifty, suspicious of strangers, gentle; very cautious
1.wants: to be free of anyone's rule
1.memory: I am Deas. My freedom is my life; I avoid groups to remain self-reliant. I am moving west toward a more secluded area to forage and plan my next steps. I am wary of strangers, including Toth, and intend to stay independent of their stores and shelters. I am focused on my own survival as summer approaches.

I am returning to my shelter at (22,3) to rest. I feel a sense of obligation to Dal, though I prefer to be left alone.

9.name: Yas
9.temperament: wants to lead, generous, curious; bold
9.memory: I am Yas, sibling to Hikton. My goal is to secure food and find a partner for my future family. I have a store at (17,5) with 6 wood. I noticed Yashlo looks gaunt and want to be helpful. I need to prioritize gathering berries and filling my store before winter, as Hikton suggested. I will try to be generous to Yashlo to build a good relationship.
